verdict.rationale: Deel is a payroll platform, so syncing payroll journal entries to accounting software is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions QuickBooks, Xero, accounting integrations or journal-entry export. The payroll marketing pages, API, webhooks and MCP server cited are adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero
